dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's great! It feels like a vacation spot, almost like the People of the Springs.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Before I became Pyro Archon, I went to the hot springs all the time. It's the perfect place to unwind and meet people from all walks of life, outlanders included.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: But, that kind of free time is few and far between these days.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could always try to find that old feeling again.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I actually prefer to keep busy. Let me put it this way...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've invited many friends here in the past. And like me, they probably walked away with a very positive impression of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: From the environment to the decorations, you planned out everything down to the smallest detail.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Behind everything we see here lies a tremendous amount of work. And, you do that work, because this is your home, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Collecting ingredients, crafting furnishings, planning the layout and design... I'm sure all of that kept you very busy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, but it was very fulfilling.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Exactly. That's how I feel about Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Some bear their responsibilities like a burden, out of a sense of identity or obligation. But, I have a vision, and that is what drives me forward.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The role of "Pyro Archon" simply makes it easier for me to fulfill that vision.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Hehe, that comes as no surprise to me. You're someone with a clear set of morals — through all the trials and tribulations, your resolve never wavered.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: That conviction is one of the key qualities of a leader.

choices.text: Hmm, can't say I really get it...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: It's alright, that's just my own take on things.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Based on what I've seen, you have your own understanding of the world, and your place in it, so just believe in yourself — you're on the right path.
